results.title: The Cavemen. @ Reeperbahn Festival Collide 2025
results.overview: Kingsley Okorie and Benjamin James, two brothers from Nigeria, combine nostalgia and contempory styles. With influences from highlife, Afrobeat, jazz and soul, they create their very own genre: "Highlife Fusion".

results.title: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
results.overview: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.

results.title: The Power of Chi
results.overview: Oscar Winner Morgan Freeman narrates this documentary about unlocking the ancient art's secrets. Watch the smallest masters beat the world's strongest and most celebrated athletes.

results.title: Say Goodbye
results.overview: Under the imposing snow-capped mountains of Utah, a Mexican family lives with the uncertainty of a loved one's disappearance.

results.title: The Frogs
results.overview: One day and one night, in a rustic country house rented by Luciana and Marcelo, who—despite having been together for eight years—have never been openly serious about their relationship. Their neighbors and friends, Cláudio and Fabiana, are seemingly happy. But it only takes getting to know them better to realize they have a very toxic relationship. Paula, Marcelo’s friend since his teens, soon understands she is entering a minefield. She decides to have a fun weekend despite the conflicts she might spark.

results.title: Frontaliers Sabotage
results.overview: When an Italian gangster plans to sabotage the taste of Swiss chocolate, a special task force is put together to avert the impending disaster.

results.title: Henry Johnson
results.overview: A quiet man is abruptly arrested without explanation, thrust into a surreal legal nightmare where truth and identity blur. As he fights to assert his innocence, he confronts a chilling system that seems more interested in control than justice.

results.title: Same Old West
results.overview: In the backlands of Goiás, Brazil, brutish men who cannot deal with their weaknesses are constantly abandoned by the women they love. Sad and bitter, these men turn violently against each other.

results.title: Nebulous
results.overview: Filmmaking turns deadly for a group of unsuspecting high school teens. NEBULOUS is the parody-ish, horror trope filled short that captures the essence of classic 80's horror films adding a sprinkle of 90's teen coming of age drama.

results.title: Khub Kacheri Keu
results.overview: A young couple navigate the complexities of an arranged marriage, which gradually blossoms into unexpected beginnings. Proving that sometimes true heartfelt connections. can be found no matter which way it was arranged.

results.title: Moinsen! Ich bin Axel Prahl
results.overview: The actor and musician turns 65 on March 26, 2025. Time for a portrait. Axel Prahl is known to a wide audience for his role as Chief Inspector Frank Thiel in the popular “Tatort” series from Münster, a character he has embodied with gruff charm since 2002.

results.title: The Papal Candidates – Who is running for election?
results.original_title: Die Papstkandidaten – Wer steht zur Wahl?

results.title: Immolation
results.overview: Andy Kodvet receives a promotion at his job, which comes with a substantial pay raise. However, he has to choose between spending the money on his long term friend Ellis, or backing out and giving the funds to his co-worker Danielle based on a certain priority she seems to have. All of this while Andy is trying to suppress his response to the heated environment he finds himself in.

results.title: All You Need Is Love
results.overview: Asunción and Mari Carmen are two young women who aspire to a position in the Women's Section, but the Beatles' visit to Spain has another destiny in store for them.

results.title: New
results.overview: The girl's morning begins in conflict with her own persona.

results.title: The Devil Whispered My Name
results.overview: A decade after a tragic ancestral ritual claimed her best friend's life, a young woman returns to her Argentinian mountain hometown, only to find the malevolent forces she thought she'd left behind are still hunting her.

results.title: Unholy Communion
results.overview: When Catholic priests with pedophile pasts begin turning up dead, a small town cop's investigation unearths buried secrets that begin to implicate an entire community.
